Round 1: REQUEST CHANGES for BUG-2701, a completing spec. Reviewed the full pinned diff on main f1a50179e5a3640451b4232e08f2e589df93e7d5. The landed tree matches the original PR head's tree. Used the generated worksheet. It has no formal Acceptance or Verify section, so the criteria below come from the requirement description and the advisor's authoritative brief.
- Adapt the nested Git fixtures to run under the dell1 lane wrapper without skipping: verified by the pinned base's fixture-only read-only rebind in expose_fixture_after_tmpfs and implementer-reported dell1 job j20261123T194458102-2-0, which ran the focused suite with zero skips or failures. The landed diff preserves that fixture wiring.
- Compare the direct-host and lane-job fixture environments: verified by source inspection of fixture_tempdir and the two wrapper callers. The normal workspace target path and the lane's temporary fixture path are handled explicitly, with the latter restored after mounting the nested /tmp. The implementer reported no separate direct-host run, and the raw dell1 output was unavailable in this review.
- Preserve the live denial and positive-control assertions: verified by the full pinned diff and inspection of the clone Git and historical-layout test callers. The assertions are unchanged and the implementer reported a passing lane run.
- Limit skips to explicitly named missing host capabilities: unverified. A broken bwrap executable can be mislabeled as absent and skipped. The stderr check can also accept unrelated text containing the allowlisted wording.
- Make any remaining skip fail the required-live gates: unverified. The required flag currently reaches an assertion in the probe, but the new skip message escapes the workflow's independent log check.
- Add a regression asserting that missing capability fails the live-required gate: unverified. The test invokes the panic helper with a hard-coded true and misses the actual probe and environment wiring.
- Keep the PR within 300 changed lines and add the BUG-2701 trace: verified by the 56-line pinned diff and the inline trace on the new helper.
- Use the specified commit subject format: verified by 9e251dbc1f5e's subject.
BUG-2701 (bug protocol): the PR touches at least one test file — met. The pinned diff changes aida-cli-lib/src/tests/bug_2169_contained_clone_bwrap_tests.rs.
CI pending at review time. Exact-head fast gates passed, fast compile was running, and FAST CI skipped the full runtime shards. The implementer reported that the targeted lane job and fast gate passed. This review used source and existing evidence.
